name: scm-diff-stats
description: A command center for your worktrees, diffs, and branch tools.

scmDiffStats.excludePaths.markdownDescription: Worktree paths that get no row. Each pattern is matched against the worktree's absolute path and against its folder name; `*` matches inside one path segment, `**` across segments, and a pattern without a wildcard also excludes everything under it. Use it to hide checkouts that are nobody's work — an agent tool's scratch clones (`**/.codex/worktrees/**`), a CI verify worktree.

path.description: Exact repository-relative vendor directory, without a trailing slash or wildcards.

scmDiffStats.vendorLibraries.markdownDescription: Additional vendored libraries, for example `[{"name":"Example","path":"assets/example"}]`. These directories are excluded from **cx** and line totals and reported separately with their uncompressed tracked size. Libraries with package metadata or a pinned npm archive in README.md are also recognized under `vendor/`, `third_party/`, `third-party/`, and `staticfiles/`. Application code outside identified library directories stays counted.

scmDiffStats.qltyCommand.markdownDescription: Path to the `qlty` CLI (https://qlty.sh) behind the **cx** column: cognitive-complexity changes vs master, from `qlty metrics` at the merge base and at HEAD. The branch total counts application code; CI and test infrastructure is excluded and shown separately in its tooltip and in grey on individual files. Identified vendored libraries are excluded and reported separately. Empty uses `~/.qlty/bin/qlty`, then `qlty` on PATH; the column stays away when no binary is found. Scoring runs in a scratch git repository under the OS temp dir, never inside the project.
